_doc: Code-quality scope + thresholds consumed by scripts/ci/check_code_hygiene.py. runtime_roots are the first-party packages held to the complexity/exception/determinism budget. excluded_roots are EVERY other top-level package that contains Python: drafts, archives, vendored code, and runtime packages NOT YET promoted into the gated set. The classification is COMPLETE: check_code_hygiene.py fails if any top-level package containing .py is in neither list (no silent ungated package). Promotion of an excluded runtime package into runtime_roots is a deliberate, reviewed scope expansion. Today's debt is frozen in docs/CODE_DEBT_BASELINE.json as a monotone-down ledger; docs/CODE_DEBT_BASELINE.json totals are themselves ratcheted by scripts/ci/check_debt_baseline_monotonic.py. See docs/adr/0026-code-hygiene-keystone.md.
